summary: Tested new /consulting-9 route (backend + frontend). All acceptance criteria met: 55/45 split desktop layout, form visible above fold, chip multi-select with exclusive 'Not Sure' both ways, inline validation on empty submit, invalid email caught, successful submission shows thank-you (c9-success) and pushes generate_lead to dataLayer only after success. Mobile 390x844 stacks intro->form, chips render 2-col, no horizontal overflow. Backgrounds for both /consulting-9 and /consulting-7 are rgb(247,248,250) (#f7f8fa). Backend accepts formVariant=consulting-9 without lastName and rejects 'consulting-99' (422).
critical_code_review_comments: Consulting9.jsx fetches `${window.location.origin}/api/contacts/submit` instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Works because the Node server proxies /api, but is inconsistent with environment-variable guideline. Low priority — consider aligning with other consulting pages for consistency.

Form token / honeypot gating relies on same-site cookie + signed X-BB-Form-Token header. The fetch call does not explicitly include credentials; it works because same-origin fetch sends cookies by default. If this page is ever embedded/proxied cross-origin, add credentials: 'include' + X-BB-Form-Token header per other variants.
seed_data_creation: One real submission posted to Atlas with email test-c9-<random>@example.com and message 'TEST - please delete'. Backend tests created one additional submission with 'TEST - please delete' marker. Total <=2 submissions as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: /api/contacts/submit requires GET /api/form-context first to obtain cookie + formToken; wait ~1.1s before POST and send X-BB-Form-Token header plus Origin. Duplicate email within 1 min -> 409; rate limit -> 429. Keep DB submissions minimal.
rca of the issue: No issue — feature works end to end.
